text.en:
Section seven of Commonwealth Act No. 141 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 7. For the purposes of the administration and disposition of alienable or disposable public lands, the
Batasang Pambansa or the President, upon recommendation by the Minister of Natural Resources, may from
time to time declare what public lands are open to disposition or concession under this Act.
"The Minister of Natural Resources shall cause to be posted in the barangay hall, the municipal or city hall
and the provincial capitol of the barangay, municipality or city and province, respectively, and to be published
in a newspaper of general circulation in the province or city where the land is situated, a list of public lands
declared open to disposition or concession, including those which have already been so declared before the
approval of this amendatory Act but which have not yet been disposed of. In addition to the foregoing, the
barangay captain shall call a barangay assembly meeting wherein he shall read and/or announce said list, and
shall certify to the district land officer his compliance with this requirement.
"Such posting and publication shall be made within sixty days from the date of effectivity of this Act, and
thereafter, within sixty days from the date any portion of the public land is so declared open to disposition or
concession.
"Hereafter no disposition or concession shall be valid unless the required posting and publication shall have
been complied with."
